visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a white knit cardigan decorated with black ribbons over a black top, sits at a white round table. She excitedly handles a large teal shopping bag with 'JELLYCAT SPACE' and a cat-in-a-planet logo. The background is a white paneled wall with a shelf holding various small items and a black lamp. (2) The scene shifts to a montage of a space-themed exhibition. Animated screens depict colorful planets, UFOs, and a small green alien walking through space. A person in a black cat mascot suit, wearing an orange and grey space jumpsuit, stands next to a red stanchion rope in a futuristic blue-lit room. (3) In a retail setting with bright blue walls, two staff members wearing grey jackets and black caps interact with customers. They hold silver metallic bags shaped like UFOs and green plush items. The lighting is artificial and cool-toned, creating a high-tech atmosphere within the store. (4) Back in the indoor room, the woman holds the teal bag. A graphic overlay appears on screen showing a collection of eight different plush characters, including a planet, a sun, an egg scientist, an alien, and a UFO, all floating against a starry blue background. (5) The woman unboxes a holographic silver cube. She pulls out a small white plush character with a fuzzy blue 'explosion' of hair, wearing a white lab coat and round glasses. She points at the embroidered details on its chest while smiling broadly at the camera. (6) She opens another holographic box to reveal a tall, green furry alien plush with large, shiny, silver-flecked black eyes. The alien has long, thin silver arms and legs. She manipulates its limbs to make it 'dance' and brings it close to the lens, expressing extreme joy. (7) The woman presents a large silver metallic plush UFO. The UFO has a smiling face and a small orange antenna. She holds it up to her face to demonstrate its size, showing that it is significantly wider than her head. She then arranges all three plushies on the table. (8) A series of close-up shots show the plush items displayed inside round glass cases under warm spotlights. Text overlays provide dates and location details for the 'Jellycat Space' popup in Seoul. The final shot returns to the mascot standing by the entrance.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Jellycat 的粉絲不得了了. [Logo]: JELLYCAT SPACE LONDON. [Slogan]: For the joy of it. (2) [Subtitle]: 今天要跟大家一起來開箱. (3) [Subtitle]: Jellycat 最新的這個外太空系列. (4) [Subtitle]: 他們在韓國的聖水洞開了一個沉浸式的快閃店. (5) [Subtitle]: 我的朋友他去那裡代購. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後就拍給我看裡面很多的影片. (7) [Subtitle]: 他就真的是非常的沉浸式. (8) [Subtitle]: 然後到處都給你一樣滿滿的情緒價值. (9) [Subtitle]: 這一次有8款嘛. (10) [Subtitle]: 我已經買了3款. (11) [Subtitle]: 然後我們今天就來一起開箱. (12) [Subtitle]: 好有質感喔. 非常有太空的感覺啊. (13) [Subtitle]: 這個是超級可愛的 瘋狂水煮蛋博士. (14) [Subtitle]: 好可愛喲. 但它有穿這個博士袍. (15) [Subtitle]: 然後再加上還有爆炸頭. 我們來開箱下一隻. (16) [Subtitle]: 好可愛. 我真的要被可愛哭了. (17) [Subtitle]: 滴滴滴滴滴滴滴. (18) [Subtitle]: 但是我告訴你. Jellycat 只要是這種特殊款式呢. (19) [Subtitle]: 它定價都比一般的還要再更貴. (20) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這隻真的好可愛. 然後你知道嗎. (21) [Subtitle]: 原本只想要買這兩隻 可是呢. (22) [Subtitle]: 因為朋友幫我代購 他就說如果你沒有飛碟. (23) [Subtitle]: 那你的外星人要坐什麼過來呢. (24) [Subtitle]: 我整個就直接被燒到. 坐好了 腳不要太開好不好. (25) [Subtitle]: 外星人就是要坐這個飛碟來你家. (26) [Subtitle]: 飛碟超大艘的. 它比我的臉還要大快兩倍. (27) [Subtitle]: 而且價格非常非常的貴 要3000多. (28) [Subtitle]: 可是它這麼可愛 你說我有什麼辦法呢. (29) [Subtitle]: 以上就是這一次的外太空系列開箱. (30) [Subtitle]: Jellycat Space 首爾快閃店. 11月5日至12月28日. [Logo]: JELLYCAT SPACE. (31) [Subtitle]: 地點位於 MM Seongsu. (32) [Subtitle]: 價錢給大家參考. (33) [Subtitle]: 有興趣的趕快去逛逛吧.

The speech rate is fast, with frequent rising intonations as she expresses admiration for the plushies. The background music remains constant in volume and rhythm. (7) A series of 'ding' sound effects are heard as price information is discussed. The speaker's tone remains friendly and conversational throughout the review. (8) The narration ends, leaving the electronic background music to play solo for a few seconds. The music fades out with a rhythmic stinger and a brief silence, marking the conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an enthusiastic lifestyle vlog and product showcase, where the creator shares her excitement over a space-themed Jellycat plush collection. By combining a physical unboxing at home with clips from a dedicated pop-up exhibition in Seoul, she provides viewers with both a sensory look at the products and travel-related event information.
